thread:
Evan Park: Need help with an offer for Mateo (contract-to-hire) in Canada. Manager wants USD-denominated comp but candidate requested local CAD pay and a short-term benefits bridge. Band lookup shows S3; manager requesting +11% uplift for 4-month contractor with conversion possibility.
Rina Gupta (People Ops): Geo uplift >10% triggers director approval. Also Canada payroll requires gross CAD equivalence and benefits bridge needs Benefits ops input. Can you share the exact numbers and start date?
Diego Ramos (Hiring Manager): Proposed USD 120k annualized pro-rated for 4 months = USD 40k + CAD one-time benefits bridge CAD 2,500. If we convert within 3 months manager will offer perm package. Start target 2026-08-03 remote Canada.
Hannah Li (Finance): For >10% uplifts we need finance director + VP sign-off. Please provide cost_center and budget_owner and total outflow in CAD. Also declare whether payment will be via EoR or direct contractor invoice.
Evan Park: cost_center: ENG-PLAT-420, budget_owner: Evan Park. Total cash = CAD 54,000 equivalent (pro-rated USD -> CAD) + CAD 2,500 bridge = CAD 56,500 gross. Candidate prefers vendor invoice but recruiting suggests EoR for speed.
Rina Gupta: If EoR, we must show gross CAD on offer. If vendor invoice, tax docs and supplier onboarding needed. Benefits bridge is unusual for contractors; need Benefits approval to create a temporary allowance and repayment clause if conversion doesn't happen.
Hannah Li: Routing suggestion: people-ops -> finance -> benefits -> legal. Ping offers-bot to create a ticket.
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-9601. Routing: people-ops -> finance -> benefits -> legal. Link: https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9601
Diego Ramos: Market note added to ticket: "Canadian market premium for model infra, immediate ramp, low-risk conversion candidate. Temporary bridge to match local health benefits during first 90 days."
Hannah Li: Finance provisional approval of cash pending benefits methodology and confirmation of payroll vehicle. Approve conditionally: CAD 56,500 gross subject to VP sign-off. :white_check_mark:
Rina Gupta: Benefits team flagged that contractors normally don't get benefits. They can approve a one-time non-taxable stipend if structured via EoR; legal wants a repayment clause if conversion doesn't proceed within 90 days. Any objections?
Diego Ramos: No objections. Add repayment/clawback clause to offer: bridge is repayable if candidate declines conversion within 90 days of start.
Hannah Li: Legal: also review worker classification risk for quick conversion and advise on wording. Recommend EoR to minimize compliance work. If EoR not possible, require supplier onboarding and CRA tax check.
Rina Gupta: I'll update APP-9601 with EoR recommendation, add the bridge clause, and upload CAD gross calc. ETA to finalize: today EOD if VP signs off.
Evan Park: Can People Ops send once cleared? Manager prefers centralized send. Also need note in offer about expected conversion timeline and how benefits transition works.
Rina Gupta: People Ops will send. I'll include expected conversion window (by month 3), the benefits transition summary, and subject line noting 48-hour decision window. offers-bot: APP-9601 updated: routed to VP Finance at 3123456820.
Hannah Li: VP Finance approved at 3123456838. Final routing to Benefits and Legal for the bridge wording and EoR confirmation.
offers-bot: APP-9601 closed: Offer cleared to send at 3123456842.
